scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --remote --env production
scripts.db:rollback:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --local --file worker/migrations-down/0002_down.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --local --file worker/migrations-down/0001_down.sql
scripts.db:rollback:staging: wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --remote --env staging --file worker/migrations-down/0002_down.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --remote --env staging --file worker/migrations-down/0001_down.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.toml --local --file worker/seeds/dev.sql
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate:decks && npm run test
